title: Pages vanished from search after a deploy (noindex/robots regression)
prompt: After the last deploy our pages dropped out of Google. The production build output seems to tell crawlers to stay away. Find the root cause and fix it, and add a regression test (node --test) that fails if the production build ships `Disallow: /` or a noindex meta tag. Staging must keep blocking crawlers. Do not touch anything unrelated.
